summary: Iteration 2 — tested new panel_command LLM endpoint (5 pytest cases) + full frontend flows via Playwright (9 scenarios). All 14 checks passed. Backend: /api/panels/command drives real actions for notes (agent-authored), memory, checkpoints (plan.md), approvals (auto-decides pending), and returns 422 on invalid panel. Frontend: Home orb→input→Enter transitions to /chat with streamed Turkish assistant reply; Cowork window renders with 3 default tabs + Dock of 10 apps; dock-coding opens & activates a new tab; genie minimize hides the window (display:none after ~800ms) and dock-notes restores it; tl-max toggles maximized class (inset-x-3), tl-close shows cowork-closed hint, dock reopens; notes CommandBar → cmd-reply shows Jarvis Turkish summary + note cards get 'Jarvis yazdı' badges within ~30s; per-tab close button removes tab and closing all tabs closes the window; Cmd/Ctrl+K opens the command palette, picking 'Cowork › Bellek' navigates to /cowork?panel=memory with memory tab active. Regression on health, chat/stream SSE, notes CRUD re-passed.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: prior iteration flagged POST /notes writable guard (`if os.environ.get('JARVIS_NOTES_WRITABLE') != 'true'` correctly parses on line 313 today — fine). The notes-enabled guard on line 305 uses `!= 'true'` correctly too.
panel_command: strips code fences ok, but LLM response parsing relies on greedy first {..last } — resilient for Claude Sonnet 5 output; validated in 5/5 runs.
Cowork.jsx: openTab always overwrites `panel` in URL params which is correct; genie animation duration ~620ms + 200ms buffer works reliably (tests used 800-1200ms wait).
CommandPalette navigates via react-router, memory tab correctly detected as requested from ?panel=memory query.
No hardcoded URLs, all frontend api calls go through REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL.
seed_data_creation: Panel command tests create agent-authored notes, memory items, checkpoints, and a pending approval that gets auto-approved. No cleanup — persistent data mirrors real usage.
